_comment: Read by dhx/dhx-key-read-guard.js. ssh_configs: files whose IdentityFile targets are protected by basename (in addition to the built-in id_<algo>[_sk][<suffix>] names). extra_key_basenames: private-key file names that appear in no ssh config. Paths may start with ~/. Override the whole file with DHX_KEY_GUARD_CONFIG=<path> (probes do).
